_about: Sea step 5d-2 cannons (game/sea_cannons.gd). A cannon stands at each ships.json cannons spot pointing outboard; a player sits seat_back m inboard of it (within seat_reach m to sit). It turns arc_deg each way from broadside and lifts pitch_min..pitch_max degrees; balls fly at speed m/s under gravity for life s; a cannon fires once per reload s. A ball that strikes another ship's hull does damage hull points (game/sea_hull.gd: hard hits hole the nearest leak zone); friendly_fire false would spare the party's own ships (true: every ship of the world fleet can be hit but the one that fired). ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS. splash_m / splash_damage (sea step 8): a ball landing within splash_m of a player hurts him up to splash_damage (less further off; never by his own ship's guns).
